name: Shortstop by the Sea
source:
Baseball is about waiting for something to happen.

Baseball is about being powerless.

Baseball is about not getting what you want.

Baseball isn't about anything.

[From [url=https://killjill.itch.io/shortstop-by-the-sea]itch.io[/url]]
